name: VerticalStackedBarChart
intent: A complete vertical stacked bar chart component that composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `VerticalStackedBarGroup`, and `ChartFooter` into a cohesive data visualization. All tokens (colours, typography, spacing, DataVis palette) come from the CSS `@layer brand` cascade — no `modes` prop, no runtime JS resolver.
